theater: 福克蘭群島與南喬治亞島

battle.name: 福克蘭戰爭
battle.theater: 福克蘭群島與南喬治亞島
battle.brief: 一九八二年四月二日阿根廷登陸福克蘭群島，英國組建遠征特遣艦隊。卡面這架一九八〇年入列的海獵鷹垂直起降戰鬥機從兩艘輕型航母上起降，承擔艦隊唯一的空中防禦、對地攻擊與目標標定；七十四天後英軍奪回斯坦利，航母還能不能用，第一次被真實的空戰驗證。

kit.name: 海獵鷹
kit.history: 垂直短距起降艦載機。福克蘭一戰證明航母還在，但數量少，制空只蓋得住特遣艦隊。

countries: 交戰的一方是英國及其自治領福克蘭群島。首相瑪格麗特·撒切爾主持政府，入侵消息確認後於一九八二年四月六日成立戰時內閣，逐日檢討軍政；國防大臣約翰·諾特與海軍參謀長亨利·利奇上將是主張出兵最力的兩人。指揮系統分三層：克里斯托弗·雷福德-布朗少將任遠征特遣艦隊總指揮；桑迪·伍德沃德中將率以「無敵」號與「大力神」號兩艘輕型航空母艦為核心的航空母艦戰鬥群，轄護衛驅逐艦、巡洋艦、潛艇與皇家海軍後勤船隊；麥可·克拉普准將率兩棲突擊群，陸上由第3突擊旅（朱利安·湯普森准將，含第2與第3傘兵營、第40與第45海軍陸戰隊中隊）與第5步兵旅（傑里米·摩爾少將，含格克哈步槍兵第一與第七營、蘇格蘭禁衛第二營、威爾斯禁衛第一營）組成。另一方是阿根廷軍政府領導的海陸空三軍：總統萊奧波爾多·加爾鐵里、空軍准將巴西利奧·拉米·多索與海軍元帥豪爾赫·阿納亞共同執政；海軍以巡洋艦 General Belgrano（五月廿五日號）、航空母艦 Veinticinco de Mayo（五月二十五日號）、攜帶微型潛艇的潛艇「聖菲號」為骨幹，另有數艘導彈驅逐艦與輕型護衛艦；空軍有「幽靈式」F-4、「天鷹式」A-4、「幻象三型」、IA-58「普卡拉」、教練機改裝的輕型攻擊機與 C-130 運輸機。島上守軍由第十步兵旅旅長馬里奧·梅嫩德斯准將指揮，兵力由入侵當日不足二千人增至五月初約一萬三千人。除交戰雙方外，智利允許英方加油並開放阿利卡港過境，秘魯供應「幻象三型」與「刺針」飛彈，蘇聯以情報衛星與暗中後勤支援阿根廷，美國提供「響尾蛇」導彈、刺針、魚叉飛彈與阿森松島的燃料補給，並把兩棲攻擊艦「關島號」備作英方航母万一有失的替身。
countriesEn: One of the belligerents was the United Kingdom together with its dependent territory, the Falkland Islands. Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher headed the government, and once the invasion was confirmed a War Cabinet was set up on 6 April 1982 to review military and political business day by day; Defence Secretary John Nott and Chief of the Naval Staff Admiral Sir Henry Leach were the two most forceful advocates of sending a force. The command structure ran in three tiers: Rear Admiral Christopher Wreford-Brown was the overall commander of the task force; Admiral Sandy Woodward commanded the carrier battle group built around the two light carriers HMS Invincible and HMS Hermes, with its escort destroyers, cruisers, submarines and Royal Fleet Auxiliary supply ships under him; Commodore Michael Clapp commanded the amphibious task group, and on land the force consisted of 3 Commando Brigade under Brigadier Julian Thompson, with the 2nd and 3rd Battalions of the Parachute Regiment and the 40th and 45th Commando Royal Marines, and 5 Infantry Brigade under Major General Jeremy Moore, with the 1st and 7th Gurkha Rifles, the 2nd Battalion Scots Guards and the 1st Battalion Welsh Guards. The other side was the armed forces of Argentina under military government: President Leopoldo Galtieri, Army Chief of Staff Ramón Woldo Bendito and Admiral Jorge Anaya took the decisions together. The navy was built around the cruiser General Belgrano, the aircraft carrier Veinticinco de Mayo, the submarine Santa Fe with its midget submarines, four missile destroyers and four frigates; the air force had F-4 Phantoms, A-4 Skyhawks, Mirage IIIs, IA-58 Pucarás, light attack aircraft converted from trainers and C-130 transports. The garrison on the islands was commanded by Brigadier General Mario Menéndez of the Tenth Infantry Brigade, and grew from fewer than two thousand men on the day of the invasion to roughly thirteen thousand by early May. Besides the two combatants, Chile allowed British refuelling and opened the port of Arica to the task force, Peru supplied Mirage IIIs and Stinger missiles, the Soviet Union provided intelligence satellites and covert logistic support to Argentina, and the United States provided Sidewinder missiles, Stingers, Harpoon missiles and fuel at Ascension Island, while also holding the amphibious assault ship USS Guam in reserve should a British carrier be lost.
people: 英方最關鍵的決策者是首相撒切爾，她拒絕撤軍、拒絕在阿根廷撤軍之前談判，並以戰時內閣這一道機制把政治判斷與軍事行動綁在一起；諾特事後主張的國防白皮書是這場戰爭留下的制度遺產。利奇上將在四月一日即令地中海演習部隊備航，準備速度決定了後來長達數千海里的追擊。海軍方面，伍德沃德中將五月二日下令攻擊巡洋艦 General Belgrano，這一決定至今仍被爭議；他事後在自傳中把整場戰爭的轉折歸於擊沉該艦帶來的士氣效果。雷福德-布朗少將負責全艦隊的續戰與補給，克拉普准將在登陸前夜決定把四千人的第3突擊旅送上聖卡洛斯灣，湯普森准將則主張不要正面強攻斯坦利而要在群島西岸建立縱深灘頭，這個選擇把戰役拉長了數星期，也讓英軍的補給線暴露在空襲之下。摩爾少將六月初接掌全部地面部隊，下令在六月十一日夜對斯坦利周邊三座山頭同時發動夜襲。空軍方面，海獵鷹中隊的中隊長傑里·普克駕駛的 GR.3 編號 XZ963 在肯特山被地面輕武器擊落，他獲頒優異飛行十字勳章；傘兵第3營的伊恩·麥凱中士在朗登山陣亡並追頒維多利亞十字勳章；威爾斯禁衛士兵西蒙·韋斯頓在布盧夫灣空襲中重傷，成為這場戰爭最著名的畫面之一。阿根廷方面，加爾鐵里在三月十九日政變後接掌國家，親自拍板出兵；海軍元帥阿納亞是軍事方案的作者，他主張讓海軍封鎖迫使英國接受既成事實；梅嫩德斯准將是守軍的實際指揮官，直到六月十四日才在斯坦利投降。外交舞台上，美國國務卿哈格四月初到倫敦做穿梭外交而未果，聯合國秘書長佩雷斯·德·奎利亞爾五月十八日提出折衷方案，兩人都沒能改變英國的立場。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the British side was Prime Minister Thatcher, who refused to withdraw the force and refused to negotiate before Argentine troops had left, and who tied political judgement to military action through the mechanism of the War Cabinet; the Defence White Paper that John Nott pressed for afterwards is the institutional legacy of the campaign. Admiral Sir Henry Leach on 1 April had already ordered a force exercising in the Mediterranean to sail, and the speed of that decision shaped the chase across thousands of miles of ocean later on. In the navy, Admiral Woodward's order of 2 May to attack the cruiser General Belgrano is still disputed; in his own memoir he credited the sinking of that ship with the turn in the campaign's mood. Rear Admiral Wreford-Brown was responsible for keeping the whole force supplied and fighting, and Commodore Clapp on the night before the landing decided to put the four thousand men of 3 Commando Brigade ashore in San Carlos Bay, while Brigadier Thompson argued for establishing a beachhead of depth on the western side of the islands rather than assaulting Stanley frontally; that choice lengthened the campaign by several weeks and exposed the British line of communication to air attack. Major General Moore took over all ground forces in early June and ordered the simultaneous night assault on the three heights around Stanley on the night of 11 June. In the air, Squadron Leader Jerry Pook, whose Harrier GR.3 XZ963 was shot down by small-arms fire on Mount Kent, was awarded the Distinguished Flying Cross; Ian McKay of 3 Para was killed at Mount Longdon and received the Victoria Cross posthumously; and Simon Weston of the Welsh Guards, badly wounded in the Bluff Cove air attack, became the best known image of the war. On the Argentine side, Galtieri, who took the country after the coup of 19 March, personally ordered the invasion; Admiral Anaya was the author of the military plan and wanted a naval blockade to force Britain to accept the fait accompli; and Brigadier General Menéndez, the actual commander of the garrison, did not surrender in Stanley until 14 June. On the diplomatic stage, United States Secretary of State Haig shuttled to London in early April without success, and United Nations Secretary-General Pérez de Cuéllar put forward a compromise formula on 18 May; neither moved the British position.
kits: 本卡兵器是海獵鷹 FRS.1，一九八〇年四月入列的英國海軍主力艦載戰鬥機，正式編號沿用海軍航空兵的 Shar 俗稱。它是單座機，一具羅爾斯-羅伊斯 Pegasus 向量推力渦扇，四個可轉噴口在垂直起降時向下偏轉，水平飛行時向後，機首裝藍狐脈衝多普勒雷達，四個翼下掛點加機腹中心線掛點；FRS.1 的武器是一至四枚「響尾蛇」AIM-9L 空對空導彈加兩挺三十毫米阿登機炮（每門備彈約一百三十發），機炮與導彈同時攜帶會壓縮續航。全役它在英軍體系裡的位置很清楚：航空母艦戰鬥群唯一的固定翼防空力量。英軍在戰區共部署二十八架海獵鷹式與十四架海獵鷹 GR.3，分屬第800、第801、第804與第809海軍航空中隊，其中海獵鷹式負責艦隊主要防空兼作對地攻擊，皇家空軍的 GR.3 才是對地攻擊主力；而論對空，海獵鷹是英軍唯一能與「幻象三型」和「天鷹式」抗衡的機型。同一套艦隊還裝備了「海標準」防空飛彈（兩艘航母各有一套）、「密集陣」近防砲系統、22型護衛艦上的「海貓」飛彈；英軍地面部隊用 105 毫米牽引榴彈砲、4.5 吋海軍砲與「吹管」便攜防空飛彈，後勤靠「海鷹」直升機（848中隊八架由驅逐艦「安特里姆」號攜帶）把炮彈與糧食送上陸，阿根廷方面則以「天鷹式」、「幻象三型」、IA-58「普卡拉」與 C-130 為主力，「超級幻象」攜帶「飛魚」反艦飛彈，是英軍最忌憚的武器，地面防線用「羅蘭」與「虎貓」導彈、三十五毫米奧利岡機炮、三十毫米西班牙-瑞士機炮與二十毫米萊茵金屬機炮構成。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Sea Harrier FRS.1, the Royal Navy's main carrier fighter that entered service in April 1980 and was known unofficially as the Shar. It is a single-seat aircraft powered by one Rolls-Royce Pegasus vectored-thrust turbofan, whose four swivelling nozzles point downwards for vertical take-off and landing and rearwards in level flight; the nose carries Blue Fox pulse doppler radar, with four underwing pylons and one centreline fuselage pylon. The FRS.1 carries one to four AIM-9L Sidewinder air-to-air missiles together with two 30mm Aden cannon of about one hundred and thirty rounds each, and flying the gun and the missiles together costs range. Its place in the British order of battle was unambiguous: it was the only fixed-wing air defence available to the carrier battle group. The British deployed twenty-eight Sea Harriers and fourteen Harrier GR.3s in the theatre, in Naval Air Squadrons 800, 801, 804 and 809; the Sea Harriers flew the main air defence task with secondary ground attack, while the Royal Air Force GR.3s provided the main strike force, and in the air-to-air role the Harrier was the only British type able to contest the Mirage III and the Skyhawk. The same fleet carried Sea Dart area defence missiles, one set on each carrier, Phalanx close-in weapon systems, and Sea Cat missiles on the Type 21 frigates; on the ground the British used 105mm towed howitzers, 4.5 inch naval guns and Blowpipe man-portable surface-to-air missiles, and the logistics of the island depended on Sea King helicopters, eight of No. 848 Squadron being carried by the destroyer Antrim to lift ammunition and rations ashore. The Argentines relied on the Skyhawk, the Mirage III, the IA-58 Pucará and the C-130, with Exocet anti-ship missiles carried by the Super Étendard as the weapon the British feared most, and their island defences were built from Roland and Tigercat missiles, Oerlikon 35mm cannon, Hispano-Suiza 30mm cannon and Rheinmetall 20mm cannon.
tactics: 英軍的戰術是一條按時間鋪開的鏈條。航渡階段，艦隊四月五日自樸茨茅斯南下，經阿森松島轉運，總航程逾六千海里；四月三十日英國宣布二百海里「總禁區」，五艘潛艇沿禁區邊緣潛航作早期預警，一架「火神」式轟炸機自本土基地起飛攻擊里奧格蘭德航空基地的計劃因此被攔下。制空階段由海獵鷹與 GR.3 承擔，五月一日第801中隊的 FRS.1 在空戰中以「響尾蛇」擊落一架「幻象三型」，阿根廷空軍此後改變戰術：讓「幻象三型」當誘餌把海獵鷹引走，「天鷹式」只作突擊機，以民用波音707與教練機改裝的「火鳳」中隊充當干擾群，掩護攻擊機突入，夜間則以「坎berra」轟炸機偷襲。破壞階段以「黑鹿」行動為主，五次行動中三次針對斯坦利跑道，飛彈與炸彈總共二十一枚卻只炸出一個坑，說明以本土基地支撐遠距攻擊代價極高。登陸階段是全役最關鍵的一步：五月二十一日夜，第3突擊旅四千人以八艘登陸艇與八艘登陸艇在聖卡洛斯灣分三個灘頭同時上陸，第八中隊在最前，第二波是傘兵第二與第三營，第三波是第四十五中隊，軍官傑里米·伍茲領隊的登陸艇波浪由側翼切入，隨後以「海貓」飛彈作為低空補充射擊掩護；空襲隨即報復，英方護衛艦 Ardent 五月二十一日中九枚炸彈沉沒，護衛艦 Antelope 二十四日因拆彈未成沉沒。地面戰採正面夜攻加縱深急行軍：五月二十七至二十八日傘兵第二營以正面夜攻打鵝綠，靠「箭」號的艦砲與第八連隊的火砲支撐，慘勝代價是英軍十八人陣亡；六月八日登陸船在布盧夫灣遭空襲，四十八名英軍陣亡；六月十一日夜三路夜襲哈麗雅特山、二姊妹山與朗登山，艦砲火力由水面艦隊提供；六月十三日夜傘兵第二營奪無線電嶺，蘇格蘭禁衛第二營奪騰伯登山，格克哈兵隨後在威廉山未遇抵抗。補給線是英軍最脆弱的一環：五月二十五日「大西洋輸送船」被「飛魚」擊中，船上四架「美洲豹」直升機與五架「韋克斯」直升機全失，島上縱深六十至八十海里的補給幾乎全靠空運與登陸船卸貨。阿根廷則把兵力佈在反斜面的坑道與地堡裡，灘頭只留少量警戒，把賭注押在夜間與低空突襲上，但島上物資靠 C-130 夜航補充，彈藥與糧食從五月底起開始不足。
tacticsEn: British method formed a chain laid out in time. In the movement phase the fleet sailed from Portsmouth on 5 April, transiting via Ascension Island, for a total passage of more than six thousand miles; on 30 April Britain declared a two-hundred-nautical-mile Total Exclusion Zone, and five submarines patrolled submerged along its edge to give early warning, which defeated an Argentine scheme for a Vulcan bomber to leave the mainland and attack the airfield at Río Grande. The air phase was fought by the Sea Harriers and the GR.3s: on 1 May a Sea Harrier of No. 801 Squadron shot down a Mirage III with a Sidewinder, and the Argentine air force changed its method accordingly, using the Mirage III as decoys to pull the Harriers away, restricting the Skyhawk to the strike role, flying converted civil Boeing 707s and a civil-flying unit known as Escuadrón Fénix as jamming escorts, and raiding by night with Canberra bombers. The interdiction phase was carried out by the Black Buck operations, three of the five missions being directed at the Stanley runway; of twenty-one bombs only one cratered the strip, which showed how expensive long-range attack from the homeland had become. The landing was the critical step of the whole campaign: on the night of 21 May the four thousand men of 3 Commando Brigade went ashore in three beaches in San Carlos Bay, with eight landing craft utility and eight landing craft personnel, the 45th Commando in the first wave, the 2nd and 3rd Parachute Battalions in the second and the 40th Commando in the third, the wave of small craft led in from the flank by Major Ewen Southby-Tailyour, and Sea Cat missiles carried as underslung loads to provide low-level fire support. The air reprisal was immediate: Ardent was lost on 21 May to nine bombs and Antelope on the 24th when bombs could not be defused. The ground battle was frontal night attack combined with fast movement in depth: on 27 and 28 May the 2nd Battalion of the Parachute Regiment attacked Goose Green frontally at night with naval gunfire from Arrow and artillery from 8 Commando Battery, winning at the cost of eighteen British dead; on 8 June the landing ships were bombed at Bluff Cove, killing forty-eight; on the night of 11 June three columns attacked Mount Harriet, Two Sisters and Mount Longdon with fire support from the ships; on the night of 13 June the 2nd Paras took Wireless Ridge and the 2nd Scots Guards took Mount Tumbledown, the Gurkhas then finding Mount William deserted. Supply was Britain's weakest link: on 25 May Atlantic Conveyor was struck by an Exocet and lost three of its four Chinooks and five Wessex helicopters, so that a line of sixty to eighty miles inland now depended almost entirely on airlift and on what the landing ships could discharge. The Argentines disposed their troops in trenches and bunkers on the reverse slopes, left only a thin guard on the beaches, and staked everything on night and low-level attack, but their island was resupplied by night C-130 flights and by late May ammunition and rations were running short.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。全役自一九八二年四月二日打到六月十四日，共七十四天。英方遠征特遣艦隊共有一百二十七艘船，其中四十三艘皇家海軍軍艦、二十二艘皇家海軍後勤船隊船隻，其餘為徵用商船與客輪，郵輪「堪培拉」號載著第42海軍陸戰隊中隊出發，「伊麗莎白二世」號在五月十二日載運第5步兵旅。航空方面，英軍在戰區共部署二十八架海獵鷹式與十四架海獵鷹 GR.3，可投入空戰的英軍作戰飛機合計四十二架；阿根廷可用噴氣戰鬥機約一百二十二架，其中約五十架擔任制空任務。海獵鷹在空戰中擊落阿根廷飛機二十架而自身無空對空損失，另有兩架海獵鷹式被地面火力擊落，一架 GR.3（編號 XZ963）在肯特山陣亡。傷亡方面，阿根廷軍人陣亡六百四十九人，其中陸軍一百九十四人、海軍三百四十一人（三百二十一人殉於巡洋艦 General Belgrano）、海軍陸戰隊三十四人、空軍五十五人、邊防警七人、海岸警務二人；英軍陣亡二百五十五人，其中海軍八十六人、海軍陸戰隊二十七人、陸軍一百二十三人、皇家海軍後勤四人、商船六人、空軍一人，陣亡海軍中二十二人來自 Ardent、二十人來自 Sheffield、二十人來自 Coventry、十三人來自 Glamorgan，受傷者英方七百七十七人、阿根廷一千一百八十八人。沉沒的英軍艦艇有驅逐艦 Sheffield（四月四日被「飛魚」擊中）、護衛艦 Ardent（五月二十一日）、護衛艦 Antelope（五月二十四日）、驅逐艦 Coventry（五月二十五日）與驅逐艦 Glamorgan（六月十一日），阿根廷方面主要損失是五月二日被核動力潛艇「征服者」號擊沉的巡洋艦 General Belgrano，艦上三百二十三人罹難。「黑鹿」一號行動中轟炸機往返一萬五千公里、投下二十一枚炸彈只炸出一個坑。卡面這架海獵鷹 FRS.1 的公開諸元因改型與狀態略有出入，大致為：空重約六點六噸，最大起飛重量約十一點九噸，最大速度約每小時一千一百公里（海平面約馬赫〇·九四），作戰半徑在數百公里量級。島上阿根廷守軍由入侵當日不足二千人增至五月初約一萬三千人，英軍先後投入地面兵力約一萬一千人。各家戰史對個別數字仍有出入，上列以主流估計為準。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are broadly as follows. The campaign ran from 2 April to 14 June 1982, seventy-four days in all. The British task force comprised one hundred and twenty-seven ships, of which forty-three were Royal Navy warships and twenty-two were Royal Fleet Auxiliary vessels, the rest being requisitioned merchant ships and liners: the ocean liner Canberra sailed with the 40th Commando Royal Marines and the Queen Elizabeth 2 left Southampton on 12 May carrying 5 Infantry Brigade. In the air the British deployed twenty-eight Sea Harriers and fourteen Harrier GR.3s in the theatre, with forty-two British combat aircraft available for air combat, against roughly one hundred and twenty-two serviceable Argentine jet fighters of which about fifty were used for air superiority. The Sea Harriers shot down twenty Argentine aircraft in air-to-air combat with no air-to-air losses of their own; two Sea Harriers were lost to enemy ground fire and one GR.3, serial XZ963, was lost at Mount Kent. On casualties, 649 Argentine military personnel were killed: 194 in the army, 341 in the navy of whom 321 died with the cruiser General Belgrano, 34 in the marines, 55 in the air force, seven in the border guard and two in the coast guard. Britain lost 255: 86 in the Royal Navy, 27 in the Royal Marines, 123 in the army, four in the Royal Fleet Auxiliary, six in the merchant navy and one in the Royal Air Force; of the naval dead, twenty-two were lost in Ardent, twenty in Sheffield, twenty in Coventry and thirteen in Glamorgan, and there were 777 British and 1,188 Argentine wounded. British ships lost were Sheffield, struck by an Exocet on 4 May, Ardent on 21 May, Antelope on 24 May, Coventry on 25 May and Glamorgan on 11 June, while the principal Argentine loss was the cruiser General Belgrano, sunk on 2 May by the nuclear-powered submarine Conqueror with 323 dead aboard. In Black Buck one, the bomber flew fifteen thousand kilometres round trip and dropped twenty-one bombs to crater the strip only once. The published figures for the Sea Harrier FRS.1 on this card vary slightly by variant and condition, but are roughly: empty weight about 6.6 tonnes, maximum take-off weight about 11.9 tonnes, maximum speed about 1,100 km/h, that is Mach 0.94 at sea level, with a combat radius in the hundreds of kilometres. The Argentine garrison grew from fewer than two thousand men on the day of the invasion to about thirteen thousand by early May, while the British put roughly eleven thousand men ashore in all. The sources still differ over individual numbers, and the above follow the mainstream estimates.
cause: 開火有兩層原因，一層是主權爭端的歷史，另一層是阿根廷軍政府自己的生存需要。群島在十六世紀初有歐洲航海紀錄，一六九〇年英國宣示佔領，一八三三年英國再度佔領並派民事官員治理，此後西班牙、法國與荷蘭先後爭奪，兩次大戰都留下主權糾紛。一九六五年英國與阿根廷簽訂意向備忘錄：一九六八年前不談主權，一九七七年起重開談判，一九八二年之前必須解決；其後的主權談判一九七四年在白宮開始，一九七八年因阿根廷堅持主權與英國堅持住民自決而破裂。一九七一年英國撤走大部分駐軍，只留小分遣隊；一九七七年談判啟動，一九七八年因阿根廷堅持主權與英國堅持住民自決而破裂，此後英國在國防檢討中把群島的常駐守軍削減到不足四十人，英國議會也傳出不再為群島撥款的訊號，倫敦遂相信威脅一旦升級就會自動退讓。阿根廷軍政府則在經濟長期蕭條與人權案件壓力下需要轉移視線。一九八一年十二月加爾鐵里上臺，三月十九日再以政變換掉一批人；三月間阿根廷海軍人員在斯坦利升起旗幟，軍政府以此作為開戰藉口，隨即定下代號「羅薩里奧行動」的方案：趁英國遠征尚未完成，以海軍封鎖配合島上陸軍登陸，速戰速決造成既成事實，再以此為籌碼談判。計畫的弱點在後勤與空軍：群島只有三個機場，最長的跑道在斯坦利而且短到無法讓高速機起降，絕大多數戰鬥機必須從數千公里外的本土基地起飛，絕大多數不能空中加油，島上碼頭與卸貨能力不足，後備役在四月初被大批徵召後才陸續上島。阿根廷高估了英國的決心，也低估了英國把海軍空前規模地派往南大西洋的意願。
causeEn: The firing had two layers of cause: the historical dispute over sovereignty, and the Argentine junta's own need for survival. The islands appear in European navigational records from the early sixteenth century; Britain declared occupation in 1690 and reoccupied them in 1833, installing civil administration, after which Spain, France and the Netherlands each in turn contested them, and two world wars left the title dispute unresolved. In 1965 Britain and Argentina concluded a letter of intent: no discussion of sovereignty before 1968, negotiations to reopen in 1977, and a conclusion required before 1982; the sovereignty talks that followed opened at the White House in 1974 and broke down in 1978 when Argentina insisted on sovereignty and Britain insisted on the wishes of the inhabitants. Britain withdrew most of its garrison in 1971, leaving only a small detachment, and the talks opened in 1977 and broke down in 1978 when Argentina insisted on sovereignty and Britain insisted on the wishes of the inhabitants; in the subsequent defence review Britain cut the permanent garrison to fewer than forty men, and there were signs in Parliament that no more money would be voted for the islands, so London believed that a threat would automatically be withdrawn if it were escalated. The Argentine military government, meanwhile, needed to divert attention from chronic economic distress and the pressure of human rights cases. Galtieri took power in December 1981 and replaced another group of men in a coup on 19 March; Argentine naval personnel raised a flag in Stanley during March, which the junta used as its pretext, and the plan code-named Operation Rosario followed: while British reinforcement was still far away, naval blockade would accompany an army landing, and a quick war would create a fait accompli to be used as a bargaining chip. The weakness of the plan lay in logistics and in the air arm: the islands had only three airfields, the longest runway was at Stanley and was too short for fast jets, most combat aircraft had to operate from bases thousands of kilometres away on the mainland, most had no air refuelling, the island's port and discharge capacity was inadequate, and reservists were only called up in large numbers in early April and reached the islands in dribs and drabs. Argentina overestimated British resolve and underestimated Britain's willingness to send an unprecedented concentration of warships to the South Atlantic.
impact: 戰爭的後果分成軍事的與政治的。軍事上最直接的產物是海獵鷹的桂冠與教訓：海獵鷹是英軍唯一可用來保護特遣艦隊的固定翼戰鬥機，空戰中擊落二十架敵機而自身無空對空損失，卻也在兩個方面暴露極限——它數量太少、無預警機護航，覆蓋範圍只及艦隊所在的海域，而英軍全役損失最慘重的恰恰是後勤船隻與直升機。這一課直接改變了英國海軍：一九八二年十二月國防白皮書擱置了裁軍計劃，兩艘無敵級航母延壽改裝，艦隊加裝並推廣「海標準」與「密集陣」近防系統，海獵鷹本身在一九八四年獲批准升級為 FRS.2（後稱 FA2），一九八八年首飛，一九九〇年訂購新機並在戰後加裝「海鷹」反艦飛彈。垂直起降艦載機這條技術路線則被越走越遠：海獵鷹的實戰表現成為美國海軍陸戰隊在八十年代中期引進「鷂式」攻擊機的參照，進而通向今日的 F-35B。外交上，撒切爾政府的聲望在戰後急升，一九八三年大選以壓倒性姿態勝出，國防大臣原本想砍的皇家海軍開支被擱置；聯合國安理會第502號決議以十票對一票通過，成為常被引用的反侵略先例，而阿根廷在軍政府失去合法性後於一九八三年恢復民主，軍人政變的歷史從此成為「馬維利亞斯」記憶與外交主張的核心。蘇聯在安理會投棄權票但暗中提供情報與後勤，美國最終公開站在英國一邊並提供實物援助，智利與秘魯的選擇也讓拉丁美洲各國重新檢視自己與英國及阿根廷的關係。中文官方媒體的報導則多從反殖民主義與民族自決的角度闡述這場衝突，中國在安理會投棄權票並呼籲和平解決，與英國的關係在戰後一度趨於冷淡。
impactEn: The consequences of the war divide into military and political. The most direct product on the military side is the crown and the lesson of the Sea Harrier: it was the only fixed-wing fighter Britain had to protect the task force, shot down twenty enemy aircraft in air combat without losing a single aircraft of its own in the air-to-air phase, and yet it exposed two limits of its own, that there were far too few of them, that they had no airborne early warning and air control cover, and that their reach extended only over the water in which the fleet was standing, while the British losses that hurt most were to supply ships and helicopters rather than to combat aircraft. That lesson changed the Royal Navy directly: the Defence White Paper of December 1982 shelved the cutback plans, the two Centaur-class carriers were extended and refitted, the fleet standardised and expanded Sea Dart and Phalanx close-in systems, and the Sea Harrier itself was approved for upgrade to FRS.2, later FA2, first flying in 1988, with new-build machines ordered in 1990 and the Sea Eagle anti-ship missile fitted after the war. The vertical take-off carrier fighter line was carried further still: the Harrier's combat performance became the reference for the United States Marine Corps when it acquired the AV-8A Harrier in the middle of the 1980s, and that in turn leads to today's F-35B. Politically, Thatcher's standing rose sharply after the war and the Conservatives won the 1983 general election in a landslide, with the Royal Navy cuts the Defence Secretary had wanted abandoned; United Nations Security Council Resolution 502 was adopted ten votes to one and became a frequently cited precedent against aggression, while in Argentina the loss of legitimacy by the military government was followed by the restoration of democracy in 1983, and the history of the coups became the core of the Malvinas memory and of Argentine diplomatic claims. The Soviet Union abstained at the Security Council but supplied intelligence and logistic support clandestinely, the United States eventually came down openly on the British side and provided materiel, and the choices made by Chile and Peru caused the Latin American states to reconsider their relations with both Britain and Argentina. In the Chinese-speaking world the official press generally explained the conflict in terms of opposition to colonialism and national self-determination, China abstained at the Security Council while calling for a peaceful settlement, and relations with Britain turned cool for a time afterwards.
result: 結局出現在一九八二年六月十一日至十四日。六月十一日夜，摩爾少將以三個旅約四千人的兵力對斯坦利外圍同時發動夜襲：哈麗雅特山以二比十八的代價拿下，二姊妹山在交火與誤傷中奪取，朗登山最艱苦，英軍在攻山期間有驅逐艦 Glamorgan 因為靠岸太近被阿根廷以改裝「飛魚」發射架擊中而沉沒，十三人罹難。六月十三日夜的第二波攻勢中，傘兵第二營配合藍營與皇家騎兵奪取無線電嶺，蘇格蘭禁衛第二營奪取騰伯登山，格克哈兵隨後在威廉山發現陣地已空。六月十四日上午，斯坦利市區的阿根廷守軍已無組織抵抗，守軍指揮官梅嫩德斯准將當日向摩爾少將投降，戰爭自四月二日算起共七十四天。英軍陣亡二百五十五人，阿根廷軍人陣亡六百四十九人，傷者英方七百七十七人、阿根廷一千一百八十八人，英方沉沒五艘軍艦，阿根廷最大損失是五月二日被擊沉的巡洋艦 General Belgrano 與艦上三百二十三人。六月十四日撒切爾在議會宣布勝利，議員起立致敬，戰時內閣運作到八月十二日才解散。六月二十日英軍接受南桑威奇群島「烏拉圭中隊」基地的投降，戰事至此完全結束。雙方都沒有得到想要的東西：英國保住了群島的宗主權，但只是靠一支遠征艦隊的奇襲；阿根廷的軍政府垮台，其領土主張在國際上並未因此確立，卻成為此後四十年外交鬥爭的旗幟。軍事上留下的是垂直起降艦載機與兩艘輕型航母能作戰的證明，以及補給線與近岸防空才是弱點這一課；政治上留下的是撒切爾政府的執政優勢、聯合國第502號決議的先例與一段至今仍未解決的主權糾紛。
resultEn: The outcome came between 11 and 14 June 1982. On the night of 11 June Major General Moore launched a simultaneous night assault on the ring of heights around Stanley with some four thousand men of three brigades: Mount Harriet was taken at a cost of two British to eighteen Argentine dead, Two Sisters was captured amid resistance and friendly fire, and Mount Longdon was the hardest of the three, with the cruiser Glamorgan struck and sunk by an improvised Exocet launcher while she was too close inshore, killing thirteen of her men. In the second wave on the night of 13 June the 2nd Parachute Battalion, supported by the Blues and Royals, took Wireless Ridge, the 2nd Scots Guards took Mount Tumbledown, and the Gurkhas then found Mount William already deserted. On the morning of 14 June the Argentine defenders in Stanley town had no organised resistance left, and Brigadier General Menéndez surrendered to Major General Moore the same day, seventy-four days after the invasion began. Britain lost 255 dead and Argentina 649, with 777 British and 1,188 Argentine wounded; five British warships were sunk, while the largest Argentine loss remained the cruiser General Belgrano and the 321 men who died with her on 2 May. On 14 June Thatcher announced the victory in the House of Commons, whose members rose to their feet in her honour, and the War Cabinet ran on until it was dissolved on 12 August. On 20 June the British accepted the surrender of the Corbeta Uruguay garrison in the South Sandwich Islands, and the war was over. Neither side obtained what it wanted: Britain kept sovereignty over the islands, but only through the surprise of a task force sent thousands of miles, while the Argentine junta collapsed and its territorial claim was not established internationally, becoming instead the banner of four decades of diplomatic struggle. What the war left militarily was the proof that vertical take-off carrier aircraft and two light carriers could fight, together with the lesson that the supply line and close-in air defence were the weak points; politically it left the Thatcher's parliamentary advantage, the precedent of Security Council Resolution 502, and a sovereignty dispute that is still unresolved.
